mentions.name: Numerikos digital math workbook
mentions.description: This app is a customizable digital math workbook. It offers a practice mode for selecting math skills to practice and a customizable dashboard where users can set up their own widgets to practice math skills in different ways, with pre-made dashboards planned to help users get started. The demo covers fourth grade math, with plans to extend to fifth grade and eventually first grade through Calculus and High School Physics. It is envisioned as a companion tool for Khan Academy/Math Class/Math Books, requires no signup, and stores progress only locally.
